items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-06-20
items.q: But I do know one thing. He's just in part of the thing. He's part of the clique.

ctx.x: But he is basically a good man. And you can go there and get any information you want. But I do know one thing. He's just in part of the thing. He's part of the clique. And there ain't nothing much he can do. But what he did for Professor Longhair, this is when I really found out that he's a good man. You see, Professor Longhair was taken. The Fess was taken. And when Mr. Weinstein found out about it, and he took over Fess's business, that's why whatever Professor Longhair had right now today is because of Mr.…
What about your dealings with 496 over the years? What did you do about it?
